Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Rui Hachimura?

Rui Hachimura is 28 years old.

Where was Rui Hachimura born?

Rui Hachimura was born in Toyama, Japan.

When was Rui Hachimura born?

Rui Hachimura was born on February 8, 1998.

How tall is Rui Hachimura?

Rui Hachimura is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much does Rui Hachimura weigh?

Rui Hachimura weighs 230 lbs (104 kg).

Is Rui Hachimura in the Hall of Fame?

Rui Hachimura is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Rui Hachimura drafted?

Rui Hachimura was drafted by Washington Wizards, 1st round (9th pick, 9th overall), 2019 NBA Draft.

What position does Rui Hachimura play?

Power Forward.

What is Rui Hachimura's net worth?

Rui Hachimura has made at least $71,341,348 playing professional basketball.

How much does Rui Hachimura make?

Rui Hachimura made $18,259,259 in 2026.

How many rings does Rui Hachimura have?

Rui Hachimura has won 0 championships.

What is Rui Hachimura's Instagram account?

Rui Hachimura is on Instagram at rui_8mura.

What schools did Rui Hachimura attend?

Rui Hachimura attended Meisei in Sendai, Japan and Gonzaga.

What are Rui Hachimura's nicknames?

Black Samurai is a nickname for Rui Hachimura.
